author: Louie Christie <6807448+louiechristie@users.noreply.github.com> (https://github.com/louiechristie/)
name: trivia-trundle
description: A a 10 question, true or false, trivia game

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:jest && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke:ios: EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_TEST_QUESTIONS=1 npm run build:ios && maestro --platform ios test tests/maestro/smoke-test-full-game.yaml
scripts.test:smoke:android: EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_TEST_QUESTIONS=1 npm run build:android && npm run deploy:android:local && maestro --platform android test tests/maestro/smoke-test-full-game.yaml
scripts.test:smoke:web: EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_TEST_QUESTIONS=1 npm run build:web && (npm run serve &) && npx --yes wait-on http://localhost:3000 && maestro test tests/maestro/smoke-test-full-game-web.yaml; EC=$?; kill $(lsof -ti:3000) 2>/dev/null; exit $EC
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:smoke:web && npm run test:smoke:ios && npm run test:smoke:android
scripts.deploy:android:local: APK=$(ls -t build-*.apk | head -n1) && if ! adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-.*device$'; then "${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}/emulator/emulator" -avd Pixel_8 -no-snapshot-load >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi && until [ "$(adb -e shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done && adb -e install -r "$APK"
scripts.deploy:ios:local: TARBALL=$(ls -t build-*.tar.gz | head -n1) && DEST=$(mktemp -d) && tar -xzf "$TARBALL" -C "$DEST" && APP=$(find "$DEST" -maxdepth 2 -name '*.app' | head -n1) && DEVICE='iPhone SE (3rd generation)' && (xcrun simctl boot "$DEVICE" || true) && open -a Simulator && xcrun simctl bootstatus "$DEVICE" -b && xcrun simctl install "$DEVICE" "$APP"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run check:ts && npm run lint:md
scripts.serve: rm -rf dist/trivia-trundle && cp -r dist dist/trivia-trundle && npx --yes serve dist
